# How to Use Pay It Forward for Your Group


by Angel | November 9, 2026


## How to Use Pay It Forward for Your Group


Planning a movie outing for a church, organization, family, school, or community group can get complicated fast.


With **Pay It Forward for Your Group** , you can purchase tickets for your group, create a custom landing page, and let each person redeem their own ticket for the showing and seat that works best for them.


Here’s how it works.


### Step 1: Set Up Your Group Page


Start on Angel’s ticketing page and select **Group Discounts** .


Choose the number of tickets you want to purchase for your group. From there, you can create a custom landing page for your members to use when redeeming their tickets.


Your group page can include:


-


A custom URL to share with your group


-


A custom QR code you can share or display


-


A custom image for your page


-


Selected showtimes where you or other group leaders plan to attend


Choosing target showtimes makes it easier for everyone to attend together, but seats are still **first come, first served** . Encourage your group members to redeem their tickets as soon as possible.


### Group Tickets Are Not Theater Buyouts


Pay It Forward for Your Group does not reserve an entire auditorium or create a private screening. Your group members redeem their tickets for seats at regular public showtimes, alongside other moviegoers.


That gives your group the benefits of organizing a shared movie experience without requiring everyone to attend a private screening or coordinate every seat in advance.


### Step 2: Share the Page and Redeem Tickets


Once your group page is ready, share the link with the people you want to invite.


Group members can visit the page, choose the showtime they want to attend, select their available seats, enter their email address, and complete their order.


After completing the order, they will receive a **QR code by email** . That QR code is valid for the theater and showtime they selected.


This means the group leader does not have to manage individual seat assignments or distribute tickets one by one.


### What If the Listed Showtimes Don’t Work?


Group members are not limited to the showtimes listed on the group page.


If none of the selected group showtimes work for someone’s schedule, they can still use the group’s code to redeem a ticket for another available **public showtime** .


Angel designed Pay It Forward for Your Group to give your whole community flexibility. Even if everyone cannot attend the same screening, they can still experience the movie and share in the conversation afterward.


### Make Group Moviegoing Easier


Pay It Forward for Your Group gives community leaders a simple way to send people to the movies without having to coordinate every ticket themselves.


Purchase the tickets. Create your group page. Share the link. Let each person choose the showing and seat that works for them.


**Use Pay It Forward for Your Group to send your group to the movies.**
